findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md:247 says the multi-model protocol should first do Tier-C M0 as "multi-key + B-4c65 revalidation" and directly reuse that M0, but the Tier-C execution plan defines M0 as only the threat model/key-management decision doc (lines 50-58), with cross-host review in M1 and pinned-key/signature provenance deferred to M-crypto (lines 60-107); the Tier-C threat model also says M0 has no implementation (lines 4-8). This blurs the M0/M1/M-crypto/M2 order and can imply already-available multi-key/runtime-ish quorum infrastructure.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 23f1f5857 by rewriting the Tier-C relationship paragraph: Tier-C M0 is doc-only decision work, M1 is cross-host/quorum, M-crypto is pinned-key/signature provenance, and this protocol no longer claims existing quorum/runtime reuse.

findings.desc: phase1-budget-lock.example.json does not bind the budget lock to any executor/reviewer snapshot, prompt digest, tool-surface digest, or protocol lock digest even though the story checklist promises snapshot digests for the budget-lock artifact (.lattice/story/actives/B-f8c6/checklist.json:183-185, :215) and the protocol makes dated snapshots/tool/prompt/budget binding a validity condition (docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md:43, :56, :152, :174-177). The example lock is keyed only by E2|task-stratified-01 with example cell keys (experiments/multi-model-ablation/phase1-budget-lock.example.json:30-56), so a future Phase 1 agent could copy the shape and treat an A2prime budget lock as reusable across provider snapshot or harness changes. Add explicit non-executable placeholder fields such as executorSnapshot, reviewerSnapshot/sourceReviewerFamily, toolSurfaceDigest, promptDigest, protocolLockDigest, and calibrationWindow/snapshotDate to keep the example coherent with the M0 traceability contract.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 23f1f5857 by adding explicit example-only bindings to phase1-budget-lock.example.json: executorSnapshot, executorSnapshotDigest, reviewerSnapshot/reviewerSnapshotDigest semantics, toolSurfaceDigest, promptDigest, protocolLockDigest, calibrationWindow, and snapshotDate.

findings.desc: CHK-003 is marked done, but its happy-path verificationIntent requires snapshot digests and the evidence overclaims that they are recorded. The recorded command at .lattice/story/actives/B-f8c6/checklist.json:213 only JSON-parses files, while its note at .lattice/story/actives/B-f8c6/checklist.json:215 says snapshot digests are present. The actual budget-lock lock object at experiments/multi-model-ablation/phase1-budget-lock.example.json:31 records budgetLockDigest/executorFamily/task/source cells/median placeholder but has no executorSnapshotDigest, reviewerSnapshotDigest, providerSnapshotDigest, or equivalent snapshot digest field. Fix by adding the required snapshot digest fields to the budget-lock example and replacing the parse-only evidence/README check with a field-level assertion.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 23f1f5857 and reverified with the strengthened README node invariant, which asserts snapshot digest fields and not_applicable reviewer semantics for the budget-lock example instead of relying on parse-only evidence.

findings.desc: The README provider-free invariant command does not actually enforce the host/model-separation failure promised by CHK-004. The checklist says the check should fail or document failure if Codex CLI is treated as a model family (.lattice/story/actives/B-f8c6/checklist.json:277-282), while README.md:27-31 only checks that each runner has a hostKind and an executorSnapshot and that providerCallEnabled is false. A registry where executorSnapshot equals "Codex CLI" or reviewerSnapshot is missing for same/cross reviewer rows would still pass that command, despite the protocol requiring model classification by executorSnapshot/reviewerSnapshot rather than app name (docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md:40-43, :56, :66). Strengthen the documented node check to reject hostKind reused as a snapshot, require reviewerSnapshot for same/cross reviewer families, and verify eligibleForOutcomeRecords remains false for examples.
